description: Cross-field constraints for grounding-envelope. Mirrors loa-hounfour constraint DSL (expression syntax · severity error/warning · fields + type_signature). Enforces the 7 grounding invariants named in patterns/grounding-ladder-as-substrate-primitive.md.

constraints.message: tier=gold requires at least one linked UTC (anti-spiral tether) · prevents gold promotion from agent-forward generation without user-truth backing
tier=gold requires grounding_status=grounded · refuted or unverifiable golds cannot anchor canon · refutation moves grounding_status, NOT tier

tier=gold requires at least one linked UTC with learning_status in [strongly-validated, directionally-correct] · weaker learning states (smol-evidence · cant-make-a-conclusion · hypothesis-failed) cannot anchor gold

constraints.expression: tier == 'silver' => operator_signed == true || (blessed_by == 'construct-consensus' && metadata.consensus_voices != null && metadata.consensus_voices.length >= 2)
constraints.message: tier=silver requires operator_signed=true OR construct-consensus with ≥2 voices in metadata.consensus_voices · prevents silent silver promotion
grounding_status=refuted requires refuted_at timestamp (when refutation occurred) · provenance trace for negative ledger

tier=gold with grounding_status=refuted preserves history but downstream integrators MUST treat as ungated · consider explicit demotion to bronze via operator action · or surface in negative ledger only
refuted_at present requires grounding_status=refuted · prevents orphaned refutation timestamps
tier=bronze with operator_signed=true suggests promotion-to-silver was forgotten · consider promoting OR explicitly demoting via operator action
contract_version != '1.0.0' · this validator was authored against 1.0.0 · check VERSIONING.md for compatibility
